rationale: Deadliest 2026 quake so far is the June 16 M6.7 in Central Sulawesi (Sigi, 3 deaths per BNPB); next most active hazard zones historically are West Java, East Java and Maluku, with monsoon and El Nino risks.
All pending SC petitions and the Feb 2026 SC plea specifically request transfer to Shifa International Hospital, Islamabad; government-run PIMS is the fallback site used so far.

Sugar surged 7.5% in May on El Nino supply fears while cereals rose 2.6% on tight wheat/maize; vegetable oils fell and dairy/meat are flat, so sugar and cereals are the most volatile leaders for Jul-Aug.
SIIA 'red' haze outlook for Aug-Sep 2026 from strong El Nino; Indonesia is the source of fires and historically declares haze emergencies (Riau 2015/2026), with Malaysia next most likely.

Barcelona are two-time defending champions (94 pts in 2025-26) but Real Madrid, under new coach Mourinho, finished second at 86 pts; early-season table after ~4 matchdays favours the traditional top two.
Over 90% of confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola cases are in Ituri, with transmission concentrated in Rwampara, Mongbwalu and Bunia health zones; North and South Kivu have only imported cases.

Standard Chartered's deal expires after 2026-27 and reports say Liverpool seeks a richer £70m+ global partner, but no successor has been named; existing partners (Google Pixel, AXA, JAL) are plausible candidates.

Lineup announced July 23; Variety-flagged contenders include Zeller's Bunker, Sorkin's The Social Reckoning, McDonagh's Wild Horse Nine and Meirelles' Here Comes the Flood; the Special Jury Prize is a jury pick that can go to any in-competition film.
UEFA ExCo meets September 15 to pick between only two bidders: Barcelona's renovated Spotify Camp Nou (Spanish government backing, 104,600 capacity) and Wembley Stadium.
El Hammamy (1,973 pts) leads Orfi (1,931) after winning the June Tour Finals; the ranking gap is narrow and Orfi has been surging, with the Qatar Classic (15-19 Sep) likely the last counting event.

Nike contract expires July 31, but L'Equipe sources put re-signing with Nike at ~50%, rivals at 10-15%, and a matching rule blocks new signings until ~early 2027, so Nike is the default as of Sept 18.

Petrochemical complexes were heavily damaged in the war (PGPIC production down 87%), so industry is likely to contract most; Iranian reports already show water/electricity at -6.5% and agriculture at -2.9% in 1404.

DOSB membership meeting on Sept 26 in Baden-Baden picks between Munich (66.4% referendum, 1972 legacy), Cologne/Rhine-Ruhr (14m tickets, 66% vote) and Berlin (parliament approval but referendum litigation risk).

Pike has a pending Tennessee Supreme Court protocol challenge (transferred May 7) after the botched Carruthers execution, but the high court is likely to rule before execution day; a last-minute SCOTUS stay is the most common outcome on execution-day filings.
